name: web-gpt-orchestrator
description: Coordinate bounded Web GPT role DAGs with explicit capabilities, structured results, exact browser ownership, and one local writer.

interface.shortDescription: Bounded Web GPT roles with one local writer
interface.longDescription: Plan and coordinate researcher, critic, solver, merger, writer and verifier roles through a durable AICC run. The plugin uses only current-turn advertised tools, enforces bounded fan-out and keeps browser, provider and workspace ownership explicit.
defaultPrompt: Split this task into Web GPT researcher, critic, writer, and verifier roles.
